title: Missing content in MSFS World Update 23? here’s the quick fix
description:
Microsoft Flight Simulator has officially released World Update 23: Poland & The Baltics (Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania)! In this video, we break down everything included in the new update—and solve a critical bug where the newly acquired content doesn't show up in your sim.

Here is a quick look at what World Update 23 delivers:
• 8 areas of interest across Poland, Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia
• 77 new handcrafted Points of Interest (POIs) including castles, cathedrals, and lighthouses
• Photogrammetry cities and updated Digital Elevation Models (DEM / TIN)
• 5 handcrafted airports by Gaya Simulations (including Jūrmala, Palanga, and Kärdla)
• 3 Discovery Flights, 5 Precision Landings, and fresh challenges

⚠️ CONTENT MISSING AFTER DOWNLOADING?
If your new discovery flights, airports, or POIs are nowhere to be found, your sim may have downloaded the package in a disabled state. Watch step-by-step how to re-enable World Update 23 inside My Library to get everything running immediately.
